purpose: Design for selecting between the doc-link and doc-db document-search backends via an ordered preference list, covering availability checks, on-demand doc-db startup, index preparation, query/update flows, and error handling.
summary: Ordered backend selection from doc_backend.prefer in .claude/.forge.yaml, default doc-link first, resolved by resolve_backend_order.py
Responsibility split: each backend owns its availability check; the SKILL orchestrates selection and fallback only on unavailability
doc-db access via a stdlib Streamable HTTP client, on-demand startup, exit codes 0/10/20/30, and an MCP tool contract snapshot
doc-db query design: series = current branch, path existence check, session-change confirmation, index-missing approval flow
doc-db update design: desired-state sync with separate --start and --status polling driven by the SKILL
doc-link flows: query-docs, freshness checked by doc-link, DLID embedding, index-docs build, no version-based availability judgment
Delegation from query-db-* to update-db-* with an explicit backend specified, and why it must be a SKILL
Component architecture, module list, use cases, and sequence diagrams for query and update
Error handling and user notification table separating unavailability, operation failure, unprepared index, and user decline
Test design: unit, wrapper, integration with injected HTTP responses, and doc-link contract tests
tasks: Implementing or modifying query-db-* and update-db-* SKILLs
Changing backend selection order or the doc_backend settings schema
Modifying doc_backend scripts such as query_docdb.py, sync_docdb.py, docdb_runtime.py
Designing fallback and error handling between document-search backends
Writing or updating tests for backend selection and doc-db client
Reviewing document index freshness and index-missing behavior
Updating the doc-db MCP contract snapshot
